conventions.origin: base centre at y=0 unless noted
conventions.weapons: origin = right-hand grip, barrel points -Z, marker "muzzle" = projectile spawn, marker "grip_L" = support hand
conventions.materials: vertex-coloured MeshStandardMaterial; materials named tint_<group> are single-colour and can be recoloured (clone material, set vertexColors=false, color.set(hex))
conventions.accessories: meshes/groups named acc_* are optional accessories: toggle visibility of the WHOLE subtree (multi-material accessories load as a Group "acc_x" with child meshes)
conventions.skinned: characters are rigidly skinned; clone with SkeletonUtils.clone(); animations included in each .glb

office_worker.usage: Gary costume = show acc_combover+acc_mustache(_crooked)+acc_glasses+acc_tie+acc_lanyard, hide hair. Tells: acc_mustache (real) vs acc_mustache_crooked (fake), acc_tie_stain, acc_watch_R vs acc_watch_L, acc_pen_ear, acc_mug.

cubicle_wall.note: Panel is 1.6m wide; tile along X to build cubicles. Both faces identical.

ceiling_light.note: Origin at top; hang from ceiling (light faces -Y).

door.note: Node "door" pivots at its hinge (left edge). Rotate door.rotation.y to open.

ac_unit.note: Spin node "fan" around Y. Good parkour step (0.9m tall).

plank.note: 3m long along Z: bridge between rooftops (wobbles when stepped on, if you want).

billboard.note: Node "face" is a 4.2x2.0 front panel: put a texture on it (see ui/textures/billboard_*.png).

wedding_arch.note: Arch spans x=-1..1, top at y=2.86. The groom must be delivered here.

wedding_ring.note: Oversized (~0.3m) on purpose: it is a held/pickup item. Spin it + bob it.

building_trim.note: 4m roof-edge parapet segment. Tile around building roofs (buildings themselves = textured boxes in code).

sticky_note.note: The "launch codes" (it just says password123). Real size; scale x3 for the beak.

signpost.note: Node "face" (1.1x0.5) takes a texture e.g. ui/textures/sign_dont_feed_geese.png

router.note: Blink led_* nodes (swap emissive). Mission: unplug, wait 10s, plug back in. Comes with power_plug + wall_outlet.

wall_outlet.note: Mount on wall (face +Z). Socket centre at y=0.3.

power_plug.note: Prongs face -Z, origin at prong base. Interactable.

framed_picture.note: Wall-mounted, back at z=0. Put a texture on node "canvas" (ui/textures/portrait_*.png).

birthday_cake.note: Flicker node "flames" (scale.y). The objective in L5: protect this cake.

bouncy_castle.note: 4x4m, open front (+Z). Players can jump in it for a super-bounce.

phone.note: Lying flat, screen up. Glow it with notifications (they are the boss projectiles in L6).

coffee_cup.note: Pickup: speed boost ("DOUBLE ESPRESSO"). Spin + bob.

dart.note: Tranquilliser foam dart: tip points -Z. Sticks to whatever it hits.

net_projectile.note: Opened net, flies along -Z. Scale from 0.1 to 1 over first 0.2s of flight. On hit, drape over target + play goose "Netted".

water_blaster.note: Scale node "water_level" on Z (0..1) for ammo. Slide node "pump" +Z to pump.

pillow_cannon.note: Shoulder-mounted: hold lower/right. Projectile = props/pillow.glb scaled 0.35.

fp_arms.note: Black-suit gloved arms. Nodes "arm_R"/"arm_L" have origin at the palm; place arm_R at the weapon origin and arm_L at the weapon "grip_L" marker (mirror pose is baked). Sleeves extend toward +Z (behind the camera).

carpet_bedroom.use: L6 giant bedroom floor (scale up a lot: you are tiny)

building_facade.use: Rooftop-level building walls (4x4 windows per tile)

poster_gary_employee.use: L1 wall poster. Leave the blank middle for a render of Gary (ui/renders/portrait_gary.png) or draw a frame.

sign_launch_codes.use: L3 sticky note close-up / HUD item

mission_failed.use: Mission failed stinger (wah wah wah waaah)

gary_hum.use: The REAL Gary hums this (positional audio, loop). Decoys never hum.

music_party.use: L5 Birthday party defence: chiptune polka

crosshair.use: Default crosshair (white, draw with a dark drop-shadow)

clue_mug.use: Clue: carries the WORLD'S OKAYEST BOSS mug

soup.use: L4 soup meter (3 bowls = food coma = fail)

logo.use: Title logo (main menu). Game title: TOTALLY PROFESSIONAL
